propositions: Status mapping must become config-driven at the outbound seam via projects.<KEY> overlays merged with built-in defaults, resolved through the S1 mapping core.
Unmapped statuses drift without failure: the outbound mapper omits the status field (Jira unchanged) and emits a deduped alert, never coerces to a fallback.
Every non-built-in status round-trips losslessly via rebar-status:<local> labels, stamped when the Jira target diverges from the built-in canonical name and recovered inbound without a reverse map.
The outbound differ resolves the per-project status map and reads [mapping] from repo_root, threading it through CREATE/UPDATE builders and both Cloud/DC adapters.
Config-declared status names must be tolerated by both the fetcher known-set and post-mapper preflight checks, widening their validation beyond built-in keys and values.
A shared helper replaces divergent _REBAR_STATUS_LABEL_TO_LOCAL literals, deriving the recovery vocabulary from _JIRA_TO_LOCAL_STATUS values to ensure every stampable status is recoverable.
